text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Wooooo!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"With golden hair billowing behind her,
this year's
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies
champion is the
unparalleled beauty,
Gold City!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow... City sure is cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while we're hard at work
training for the
Hanshin J.F., Yukino Bijin
requests that we watch
a recording of
one of Gold City's races.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna be like City—just chocked
full of
dazzl'n glitz and glam!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Which is why this video always gets my
blood
pump'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Roger dodger!
choice_data_list: その調子！今日も頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: That's the spirit! Let's give it our all today too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is more than motivated
enough to
work hard. Aside from that,
her surge in
popularity has been begun
to show subtle
changes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And hello to you, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Curren Chan, one of Yukino
Bijin's
classmates and a wildly popular
social media
influencer.
choice_data_list: こんにちは
choice_data_list_en: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Curren! Did you need me for
someth'n?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You guessed it! Check out this
Curren-exclusive
breaking news!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is that... my name in the trend'n
section?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're blowing up big-time on
Umatter
right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But why?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Seems like your announcement about
the Triple
Tiara put you on everyone's
radar.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone wants to see you in a tiara!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw gee whiz!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, and just so you know, I'm one of
them. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A country girl winning it big in the city!
That's
like a real #CinderellaStory!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not sure what the Triple Tiara is, but
she
seems strong. I'm gonna go to her
race!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is amazing! There's so many
comments... So,
this is what it's like to go
viral?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? This article title...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Yukino Bijin—Superstar from the
Boonies or
Passing Fad?"
choice_data_list: どうしたんだ？
どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: What's the matter?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The article goes on to compare Yukino
Bijin to a
certain Umamusume who bears
the title of "the
Beast."
choice_data_list: ……見せてごらん
choice_data_list_en: ...Let me see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap—the so-called Beast from
Kasamatsu,
is an Umamusume from the
countryside who's
made a huge name for
herself, claiming historic
wins left and
right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the article notes that Yukino
Bijin and
Oguri Cap are not the same. It
claims Yukino
Bijin's popularity comes
from her looks and not
her actual talent.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Whether she likes it or not, trying for
the Triple
Tiara means showing us what
she's actually worth.
Let's wait and see if
Yukino Bijin will be able to
prove
herself"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, you don't need t'worry! I'm just
peachy,
really!
choice_data_list: ユキノ――
choice_data_list_en: Yukino—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, they're not wrong. I haven't won
any races
yet. I'm still just gett'n started
as a runner, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna do my best. I'll put
everyth'n I've
got into my races and
prove I'm the real
deal—just like Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All there is to it... is to do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It'll take time, but the results'll speak for

themselves! First things first, I've got
t'sharpen my
skills!
choice_data_list: そうだな
そうだね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're right.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin here's rar'n to go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, I've gotta get t'class! See ya!
choice_data_list: （この子は本当に前向きだなぁ）
choice_data_list_en: (She's just so positive.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm still not good enough. 'Course I'm
not.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, guess I'll just hafta be better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Training goes smoothly for a while
following that
little incident... until it
doesn't.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-huh?
choice_data_list: 大丈夫？
choice_data_list_en: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-oh, yes. I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... I s'pose you're right. I guess I
pushed
myself too hard.
choice_data_list: なんか……すごく疲れてないか？
なんか……すごく疲れてない？
choice_data_list_en: Is it just me, or... do you look completely exhausted?
Is it just me, or... do you look really exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she did push herself, this
particular set of
exercises shouldn't have
drained her to this
extent. She had no
issues when we did these
before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... You don't have t'worry. I'm okay,
really.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
choice_data_list: ……本当に？
choice_data_list_en: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I'm still tuckered out from
last night's
train'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I ran a mountain trail, lifted logs,
and did as
many uphill sprints as I could
handle...
choice_data_list: 自主トレしてたのか？
自主トレしてたの？
choice_data_list_en: Were you training on your own?
Were you training on your own?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's watch'n me, but I'm nowhere
near
good enough t'live up to their
expectations the
way I am now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I started panick'n, think'n I've gotta get
good real
fast if I don't wanna
disappoint everyone...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll ever be able t'become a
glam'rous
city girl like her...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It'll take time, but the results'll speak for

themselves! First things first, I've got
t'sharpen my
skills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her optimism is as genuine as it
gets, she
always seems uncertain about
her actual skills.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um... Should I not've done all that?
choice_data_list: （だから、頑張ろうとしすぎちゃったんだ）
choice_data_list_en: (That's why she pushed herself too hard.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every training program I put together for
her is
designed with balance in mind. If
she does extra
training on top of it,
she'll overexert herself.
choice_data_list: 自主トレは悪いことじゃないよ、ただ……
choice_data_list_en: Independent training isn't a bad thing, it's just...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: 不安なところは、一緒に考えていきたいんだ
不安なところは、一緒に考えていきたいな
choice_data_list_en: If there's anything you're anxious about, I want to work through it together.
If there's anything you're anxious about, I'd like to work through it together.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No way that's true! I mean, it's not like
y'decided
on this path all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
If your trainer thinks y'can do it, I'm sure
you'll be
golden!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gee will'kers! Yukino, you big ol'
dummy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just realized I should've come t'you for
advice.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But instead, I went charg'n off on my
own and
made you worry...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You don't have t'apologize!
choice_data_list: 俺も不安に気づけなくてごめん
私も不安に気づけなくてごめん
choice_data_list_en: I'm sorry I didn't notice how anxious you were, either.
I'm sorry I didn't notice your anxiety either.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? There isn't?
choice_data_list: でも、焦らなくて大丈夫だ
でも、焦らなくて大丈夫だよ
choice_data_list_en: Still, there's no need to rush.
Still, there's no need to rush, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've seen what Yukino Bijin is made of,
and I'm
certain her talent is genuine. No
matter the race
or opponent, I know
she'll deliver fantastic
results.
choice_data_list: コツコツ頑張れば、君は絶対大丈夫
コツコツ頑張れば、貴方は絶対大丈夫
choice_data_list_en: As long as you take it step by step, you'll definitely be fine.
As long as you take it step by step, you'll definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 君なら、走りでブームを本物にできる！
貴方なら、走りでブームを本物にできる！
choice_data_list_en: Your running can make this craze the real deal!
With your running, you can turn this hype into something real!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was just think'n about everyone back
home.
choice_data_list: どうした？
どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: What's wrong?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How they all told me what a good runner
I am and
how they know everything'll
turn out okay for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hear'n that made me so happy and
thankful... It
warmed my heart right up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way right now. I can't let
myself
lose conf'dence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems determined, but it's not like
she can
flip a switch to gain confidence
in herself and
banish her anxiety. I try to
think of what I can do
to bolster her
spirits more, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Plus, Mifuyu said I'd be fine too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu is Yukino Bijin's closest friend. I

exchanged contact information with her
when she
came to Tokyo to wish Yukino
Bijin luck before
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words hold great sway over Yukino
Bijin. It'd
be great if she could come and
cheer her on in
person...
choice_data_list: （美冬さんか……）
choice_data_list_en: (Mifuyu-san, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I contact Mifuyu to ask if
she'd be
able to come and watch Yukino
Bijin run in the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
